J-01.name: Watch a ticker and see the live tape cockpit
J-01.notes: MAJOR ADVANCE over iter-1's backend-only partial: the cockpit is now FULLY browser-rendered (HTTP 200, iter-1 500-trap closed) and ALL data/behavior assertions are screenshot-proven — six panels populate with live numeric values, spread=ask-bid (0.02), and values update over WebSocket WITHOUT a page reload (Last 115.19->122.62, Bid 115.18->122.60 across captures; href constant). On scenario end (stream_status:closed) the UI correctly FROZE the final snapshot (no fabricated post-stream updates). Blocked from `passing` ONLY by a real, root-caused CSS color-semantics defect: .text-emerald-400 / .bg-emerald-500 are absent from the served Tailwind bundle (dynamic-only classes from lib/format.ts never safelisted), so the headline 'Buyer Control' state color and the confidence-bar fill render colorless (slate/transparent) instead of green — degrading the at-a-glance cockpit's stated design-direction color language. Promote to `passing` after the safelist fix + browser re-verify shows the color layer green.

J-02.name: Buyer-control scenario is identified
J-02.notes: Data/behavior fully browser-proven (screenshot-backed): tape state settles on buyer_control @ confidence 0.888 (>= threshold); aggressive_buy_ratio 0.955 (high); buy_price_impact +0.390 (POSITIVE — price-impact guard intact, NOT relaxed); Event Log shows exactly 'Tape state changed to buyer_control'. Blocked from `passing` ONLY by the shared emerald CSS defect: the browser sub-test UT-06 FAILED on its explicit color assertion (the 'Buyer Control' headline and the positive buy_price_impact value compute slate-200 rgb(226,232,240), not emerald). The classification substance is correct; only the green color layer is broken. Promote after the safelist fix + browser re-verify.

Browser-proven exact agreement between the UI and GET /tape/SIM-BUYER/state + /features across 11 metrics (tape_state buyer_control; confidence UI 0.888 == REST 0.8882; aggressive_buy_ratio 0.955==0.9545; net_aggressive_volume 14000; buy_price_impact 0.390; sell_price_impact -0.120; average_spread 0.020; trade_speed 2.03/s; etc.), UI 30s window == REST primary_window. Reinforced this iteration: the tape_engine.py:54 cleanup removed the duplicate inline ask-bid so spread now has exactly one canonical producer (MarketState.spread) — coherence Part A PASS.
